csv_agency: County of Ventura Department of Airports
csv_scope_of_work: The Ventura County Department of Airports (County) owns and operates two public-use general aviation airports: Camarillo Airport (CMA) and Oxnard Airport (OXR). The County is responsible for maintaining, improving, and expanding infrastructure at both airports to support safe and efficient operations and to meet applicable regulatory requirements. The County regularly undertakes capital improvement projects that may include the planning, design, rehabilitation, and construction of airfield facilities such as runways, taxiways, aircraft parking aprons, lighting systems, drainage infrastructure, buildings, and other airport support facilities.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Transportation Planning

title: Airport Engineering Design & Architectural
short_description: On-call airport planning and design services for infrastructure projects at two Ventura County airports.
project_location: Camarillo, California, USA; services also cover Oxnard Airport, Ventura County, California, USA.
project_scope: The Ventura County Department of Airports seeks support for capital improvement projects at two public-use general aviation airports: Camarillo Airport (CMA) and Oxnard Airport (OXR). The program may include planning, design, rehabilitation, and construction-related services for airfield and airport infrastructure such as runways, taxiways, aircraft parking aprons, lighting systems, drainage infrastructure, buildings, and other airport support facilities. No technical quantities, spans, areas, or building sizes are stated.
services: Architecture, interior design/space planning, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and transportation planning; on-call engineering design and architectural services under up to five contracts for a 60-month term.
relevance_explanation:
- Broad airport on-call framework with multiple disciplines rather than a defined structural project.
- Includes buildings and civil infrastructure, but no specific long-span, bridge, roof, or special structural scope is identified.
- Strong focus on architecture, MEP, airport civil works, and general planning, which only partially matches sbp's profile.
- Could contain occasional structurally relevant tasks, but the notice provides no concrete evidence of complex load-bearing structures.
- Multiple-award on-call format reduces strategic attractiveness compared with a specific design commission.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the notice. The procurement is for on-call professional services covering future airport capital improvement projects at Camarillo and Oxnard airports, potentially including runways, taxiways, aprons, lighting, drainage, buildings, and support facilities. Because no project list, quantities, or program values are provided, a realistic overall construction cost estimate is not possible from the available information.
fee_explanation: No design fee or contract value is stated. Up to five contracts may be awarded for a 60-month term, funded by FAA-related airport capital projects, but the notice gives no upset amount, task-order volume, or estimated professional services budget.
contracting_authority: County of Ventura Department of Airports, Camarillo, California, USA. Contact: Danielle Tarr. Phone: 805-388-4205. Fax: 805-388-4366. Email: danielle.tarr@venturacounty.gov. Website: https://ventura.bonfirehub.com/opportunities/236180
notes: Project number AIR-26-01. FAA-funded. Questions deadline: 2026-06-10 05:00 PM PDT. Up to five contracts may be awarded. Contract duration: 60 months. The notice covers both Camarillo Airport and Oxnard Airport despite the listed location being Camarillo.
